name: grom
description: Your local AI assistant. Runs entirely on your machine — no cloud, no account, no telemetry. Powered by Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible API.

name.description: Display name for this MCP server

command.description: Command to launch the MCP server, e.g. npx

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

grom.mcpServers.markdownDescription:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to connect to. Each server exposes tools the model can call.

Example:
```json
[
  {
    "name": "filesystem",
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path/to/workspace"]
  }
]
```

grom.ragEnabled.description: Enable codebase indexing for smarter context retrieval (RAG). Indexes your workspace files on startup.

grom.embeddingModel.markdownDescription:
Ollama model to use for semantic RAG embeddings. Leave blank to use keyword search (TF-IDF) only.

Recommended models (run `ollama pull <name>` first):
- `nomic-embed-text` — fast, 274MB, great quality
- `mxbai-embed-large` — larger, higher accuracy
- `all-minilm` — very fast, smaller

With an embedding model, Grom understands meaning — `fetch data` will find chunks about `axios.get`.

grom.autocomplete.description: Enable inline code completions (ghost text) as you type.

grom.autocompleteModel.markdownDescription:
Model to use for inline completions. Leave blank to use the same model as chat.

For best results use a dedicated FIM (fill-in-middle) model — these are trained specifically for code completion and are much faster:
- `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` — fast, good quality
- `deepseek-coder:1.3b` — very fast
- `starcoder2:3b` — strong multi-language

Run e.g. `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` to download.

grom.apiUrl.description: Base URL for your local LLM server (Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434, LM Studio: http://127.0.0.1:1234)

useOllamaFormat.description: Use Ollama /api/chat format. Uncheck for OpenAI-compatible APIs.

grom.customProviders.markdownDescription:
Custom LLM providers to add to the provider dropdown. Each entry needs a `name`, `url`, and optionally `useOllamaFormat` (default: false for OpenAI-compatible).

Example:
```json
[
  {
    "name": "My Local Server",
    "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080",
    "useOllamaFormat": false
  }
]
```

grom.useOllamaFormat.description: Whether to use Ollama's /api/chat format. Uncheck for LM Studio / OpenAI-style APIs.

grom.modelPricing.description: Model pricing: input/output per 1M tokens, context window size.

grom.theme.description: The visual theme for the chat interface.

grom.robotAnimations.description: Enable interactive robot animations (eye-tracking, idle thoughts, and sleep mode).

grom.languageModels.markdownDescription:
Override the model for specific languages in both chat and autocomplete (fallback if the specific maps below are not set). Keys are VS Code language IDs.

Example:
```json
{ "python": "qwen2.5-coder:1.5b", "typescript": "qwen2.5-coder:32b" }
```

grom.chatLanguageModels.markdownDescription:
Override the chat model for specific languages. Takes priority over `grom.languageModels`. Keys are VS Code language IDs.

Example:
```json
{ "python": "deepseek-coder-v2", "rust": "qwen2.5-coder:32b" }
```

grom.autocompleteLanguageModels.markdownDescription:
Override the autocomplete model for specific languages. Takes priority over `grom.languageModels`. Keys are VS Code language IDs.

Example:
```json
{ "python": "qwen2.5-coder:1.5b", "go": "deepseek-coder:1.3b" }
```

grom.agentEnabled.description: Enable the agentic loop. When on, Grom can read/write files, search, and run terminal commands autonomously to complete tasks. Disable to return to simple single-shot responses.

grom.agentMaxIterations.description: Maximum number of tool-call iterations per agent task before the loop stops.

name.description: Short name shown in @docs results, e.g. "react"

grom.docSources.markdownDescription:
External documentation sites for Grom to index. Use `@docs` or `@docs:name` in chat to search them.

Example:
```json
[
  { "name": "react", "url": "https://react.dev/reference/react" },
  { "name": "mdn", "url": "https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference" },
  { "name": "vscode", "url": "https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api" }
]
```

Grom crawls up to 40 pages per source, respecting same-origin links.

grom.customGreeting.description: Override the greeting message shown in the empty chat state. Leave blank for the default.

grom.customLogo.markdownDescription: Override the chat logo. Can be a URL (`https://...`), a `data:` URI, or a single emoji/text character.
